{"explanation": "This invoice from Kransberg Clearing & Forwarding (Pty) Ltd (invoice 098052, total 1966.16 ZAR) was held because three line items are billed far above the PO unit prices, beyond the tolerance of 1: Documentation fee at 508.52 versus an expected 24.8, Delivery order handling at 725.32 versus 39.31, and Cargo inspection attendance at 475.86 versus 25.79. Check the PO PO-UALUSDZAR3 pricing and confirm whether these charges were agreed, then ask the vendor to correct the lines or confirm the rates before any payment decision is made.","email_subject": "Invoice 098052 – Pricing Discrepancies on PO-UALUSDZAR3","email_body": "Dear Kransberg Clearing & Forwarding team,

Thank you for invoice 098052 dated 2026-02-06 for a total of 1966.16 ZAR, referencing PO-UALUSDZAR3.

During our review, we found that the following line items do not match the unit prices on the purchase order:

- Documentation fee: billed 508.52; PO unit price 24.80 (quantity 1)
- Delivery order handling: billed 725.32; PO unit price 39.31 (quantity 1)
- Cargo inspection attendance: billed 475.86; PO unit price 25.79 (quantity 1)

Could you please review these lines and either issue a corrected invoice reflecting the PO pricing or confirm in writing the rates that apply? Once we receive your response, we will continue processing.

Thank you for your assistance.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable"}
